boundary.host: Private app: UI, current document envelopes, transforms, opacity, p5 lifecycle, composition and storage
boundary.savedArtwork: Disposable; no legacy document migration or compatibility obligation
boundary.removed: App-local adapters, copied instrument guides/content, historical Studio snapshots and migration paths; operation teaching copy remains app-owned

constructions.artistTask: Build a shaped, open color field or a local band fragment.
constructions.controls: Piecewise left/right silhouette, count, coverage, non-restretching global trim, placement and palette/custom Oklab stops.

constructions.artistTask: Build open fans, eccentric shells or nested color arcs.
constructions.controls: Radius spacing, aspect, total center drift and twist, signed arc traversal, independent sampling/stroke and rank/arc coloring.

constructions.artistTask: Reduce authored colors into weighted strips or tiles without losing their area relationships.
constructions.controls: Palette ramp or weighted sequence, actual median-cut colors, stable grouping/seeded shuffle, columns, footprint, stagger and independent gaps.

creativeReview.observed: Root used actual controls, inspected defaults and nine contrasting variants, exact entries outside slider ranges, three zero-ink states, five invalid-edit scenarios retaining the last valid canvas, and shuffle reseed/Undo. Root reviewed all six layered results; the orbit partner was moved into meaningful overlap before final review.
creativeReview.guides: Package-owned guides updated and reviewed for the library/host boundary; no acceptance bookkeeping added to teaching copy.

verification.offlineReleaseBuild: passed: three archives installed into an isolated consumer, inventory/default admission/imports and package bytes checked

nativeInstalled.scope: Standalone README consumer with caller-supplied p5 2.3.2 and no private app code; cold local timing, not a universal latency guarantee

verification.readmeExample: The documented bandCoverage=0.58 edit rendered successfully.
verification.webglHost: All four actual WebGL detail pages reached ready and were visually inspected alongside library output. Host composition differs from the standalone no-tint path; cross-host pixel equality is not claimed for these four.
verification.privateChecks: 30 initial focused cases plus 231 remaining migrated behavior cases passed across focused runs after retiring five obsolete fixed-source/registry assertions. The final eight public preparation/cancellation cases, typecheck and generated-data checks passed. Not a whole-private-suite claim.
verification.regression: Growth coupled limits formerly passed public admission and failed only during drawing. The new admission test failed against the predecessor dist, then passed after binding the existing three growth validators; no budget or algorithm semantics changed.
verification.publishedPins: Downloaded assets, app package.json/package-lock and deploy/runtime-inputs agree on URLs, versions, SHA-256 and npm integrity. Only the lock root and the three toolkit package entries changed.
verification.publishedConsumerSmoke: Actual app-installed release imports admitted all 117 defaults, rejected the three growth budget violations and reported cooperative cancellation.
verification.deploymentAcquisition: The actual deployment download/checksum helper fetched and verified all three published toolkit archives; full renderer/toolchain acquisition was not rerun.
verification.visualGallery: Built 135 groups and 967 images with no problems; root opened the real gallery, selected the creative-review stage and inspected its rendered section.

limitations: No whole-gallery creative acceptance; the remaining 25 IDs retain source-level dispositions only.
No app deployment, authenticated Studio, persistence/export, tenant or visitor acceptance.
No new public core algorithm, operation target acceptance, corpus recreation or cross-target parity.
Historical catalog contract wording and bound target reviews are not reconciled by this release.
Auth schema-generation provenance remains untouched. Its whole-lock hash already differed before final toolkit pinning; the auth dependency graph did not change.
historicalPredecessors: Private docs/study-quality-audit.md and .work/instrument-second-pass/ retain their scoped creative evidence.
The earlier 0.2.2 candidate artifacts remain in .work/dist/web-toolkit-v0.2.2-verified; the released successor is .work/dist/web-toolkit-v0.2.2-final.
